en.setting: The Blackwood Club occupies a Georgian house behind a wrought-iron gate, where leather chairs face a fireplace and the port ceremony follows Thursday dinner as it has for decades. The archive vault below holds trust deeds and committee minutes dating back to 1870, and tonight a literary executor has requested the originals.
en.crime: Arthur Crisp was found in his reading room chair with a port glass beside him. The fire had burned to ash, the room was cold, and the antimony dissolved in his evening port had done its work before midnight.

suspects.name: Agnes Vail
suspects.intro: Wore black gloves throughout the evening and signed the guest book with a leftward slope matching the forged signature on the trust deed.

suspects.name: Hugh Emberly
suspects.intro: Took his usual chair by the fire, his monogram ring leaving an imprint on the leather armrest.

suspects.name: Colonel Norris
suspects.intro: Decanted and served the port himself, as he has done for twenty years.

suspects.name: Dr Pryce
suspects.intro: Pronounced death at half past seven and completed a detailed toxicology report by nine.

suspects.name: Lillian March
suspects.intro: Crossed the rear garden to speak with the night watchman, her coat carrying rain and her hem muddied.

suspects.name: Percival Dent
suspects.intro: Accessed the archive vault that afternoon, claiming he was cataloguing the 1920s minutes.

suspects.name: Walter Kemp
suspects.intro: Sat in the far corner and said nothing until asked, having known the Vail family from his years at the trust office.

es.setting: El Club Blackwood ocupa una casa georgiana detras de una verja de hierro forjado, donde sillones de cuero miran a una chimenea y la ceremonia del oporto sigue a la cena del jueves como lo ha hecho durante decadas. La boveda del archivo debajo guarda escrituras fiduciarias y actas del comite que datan de 1870, y esta noche un albacea literario ha solicitado los originales.
es.crime: Arthur Crisp fue encontrado en su sillon de la sala de lectura con una copa de oporto a su lado. El fuego se habia consumido en cenizas, la habitacion estaba fria, y el antimonio disuelto en su oporto vespertino habia hecho su trabajo antes de la medianoche.

suspects.name: Agnes Vail
suspects.intro: Llevo guantes negros durante toda la velada y firmo el libro de invitados con una inclinacion a la izquierda que coincide con la firma falsificada en la escritura fiduciaria.

suspects.name: Hugh Emberly
suspects.intro: Ocupo su sillon habitual junto al fuego, su anillo con monograma dejando una huella en el reposabrazos de cuero.

suspects.name: Coronel Norris
suspects.intro: Decanto y sirvio el oporto el mismo, como lo ha hecho durante veinte anos.

suspects.name: Dr Pryce
suspects.intro: Declaro la muerte a las siete y media y completo un informe toxicologico detallado a las nueve.

suspects.name: Lillian March
suspects.intro: Cruzo el jardin trasero para hablar con el vigilante nocturno, su abrigo con lluvia y su dobladillo embarrado.

suspects.name: Percival Dent
suspects.intro: Accedio a la boveda del archivo esa tarde, alegando que catalogaba las actas de los anos 20.

suspects.name: Walter Kemp
suspects.intro: Se sento en el rincon mas alejado y no dijo nada hasta que se le pregunto, habiendo conocido a la familia Vail por sus anos en la oficina fiduciaria.

fr.setting: Le Club Blackwood occupe une maison georgienne derriere une grille en fer forge, ou des fauteuils en cuir font face a une cheminee et la ceremonie du porto suit le diner du jeudi comme depuis des decennies. La chambre forte des archives en dessous conserve des actes fiduciaires et des proces-verbaux du comite remontant a 1870, et ce soir un executeur literaire a demande les originaux.
fr.crime: Arthur Crisp a ete retrouve dans son fauteuil de la salle de lecture avec un verre de porto a cote de lui. Le feu s'etait consume en cendres, la piece etait froide, et l'antimoine dissous dans son porto du soir avait fait son oeuvre avant minuit.

suspects.name: Agnes Vail
suspects.intro: A porte des gants noirs toute la soiree et signe le livre d'or avec une inclinaison vers la gauche correspondant a la signature falsifiee sur l'acte fiduciaire.

suspects.name: Hugh Emberly
suspects.intro: A pris son fauteuil habituel pres du feu, sa chevaliere a monogramme laissant une empreinte sur l'accoudoir en cuir.

suspects.name: Colonel Norris
suspects.intro: A decante et servi le porto lui-meme, comme il le fait depuis vingt ans.

suspects.name: Dr Pryce
suspects.intro: A prononce le deces a sept heures et demie et complete un rapport toxicologique detaille a neuf heures.

suspects.name: Lillian March
suspects.intro: A traverse le jardin arriere pour parler au veilleur de nuit, son manteau portant la pluie et son ourlet boueux.

suspects.name: Percival Dent
suspects.intro: A accede a la chambre forte des archives cet apres-midi, pretendant cataloguer les proces-verbaux des annees 1920.

suspects.name: Walter Kemp
suspects.intro: S'est assis dans le coin le plus eloigne et n'a rien dit jusqu'a ce qu'on le lui demande, ayant connu la famille Vail depuis ses annees au bureau fiduciaire.

all_strong.en: Agnes Vail had forged the third signature on the trust deed in 1935 and lived in fear of its discovery for decades. When Arthur Crisp found the ink discrepancy and requested an independent analysis, she switched his port glass in the kitchen passage and dissolved the antimony that would silence him before the committee met. The nib matched her Waterman pen, the blotting paper held the reverse of the forged signature, and the measured dose spoke of pharmaceutical precision. The third signature had held for forty years. It took one evening of port and poison to bring it down.
all_strong.es: Agnes Vail habia falsificado la tercera firma en la escritura fiduciaria en 1935 y vivio con el temor de su descubrimiento durante decadas. Cuando Arthur Crisp encontro la discrepancia de tinta y solicito un analisis independiente, ella cambio su copa de oporto en el pasillo de la cocina y disolvio el antimonio que lo silenciaria antes de la reunion del comite. La plumilla coincidia con su pluma Waterman, el papel secante guardaba el reverso de la firma falsificada, y la dosis medida hablaba de precision farmaceutica. La tercera firma se habia mantenido durante cuarenta anos. Basto una velada de oporto y veneno para derribarla.
all_strong.fr: Agnes Vail avait falsifie la troisieme signature sur l'acte fiduciaire en 1935 et vecut dans la crainte de sa decouverte pendant des decennies. Quand Arthur Crisp decouvrit l'anomalie d'encre et demanda une analyse independante, elle echangea son verre de porto dans le passage de la cuisine et y dissolut l'antimoine qui le reduirait au silence avant la reunion du comite. La plume correspondait a son Waterman, le buvard portait l'envers de la signature falsifiee, et la dose mesuree temoignait d'une precision pharmaceutique. La troisieme signature avait tenu quarante ans. Il a suffi d'une soiree de porto et de poison pour la faire tomber.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Agnes Vail's name settled over the Blackwood Club like the ash in the reading room grate. The handwriting matched, the motive was clear, and everyone recalled the way she set down her glass before answering questions. But the port glass had been wiped clean, the antimony source was never traced, and the kitchen passage offered no witnesses. She was tried on the strength of a forged signature and the weight of forty years of silence. The conviction held, but the club never served port on Thursday again.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: El nombre de Agnes Vail se poso sobre el Club Blackwood como las cenizas en la rejilla de la sala de lectura. La escritura coincidia, el motivo era claro, y todos recordaban como dejaba su copa antes de responder preguntas. Pero la copa de oporto habia sido limpiada, la fuente del antimonio nunca fue rastreada, y el pasillo de la cocina no ofrecio testigos. Fue juzgada por la fuerza de una firma falsificada y el peso de cuarenta anos de silencio. La condena se sostuvo, pero el club nunca volvio a servir oporto los jueves.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Le nom d'Agnes Vail s'est depose sur le Club Blackwood comme la cendre dans la grille de la salle de lecture. L'ecriture correspondait, le mobile etait clair, et tous se souvenaient de la facon dont elle posait son verre avant de repondre aux questions. Mais le verre de porto avait ete essuye, la source de l'antimoine n'a jamais ete retracee, et le passage de la cuisine n'offrait aucun temoin. Elle fut jugee sur la force d'une signature falsifiee et le poids de quarante ans de silence. La condamnation a tenu, mais le club n'a plus jamais servi de porto le jeudi.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong member was accused, and Agnes Vail left the Blackwood Club with her gloves on and her family's trust intact. The forged deed remained in the archive vault, the property stayed in Vail hands, and Arthur Crisp's discovery was quietly filed among the committee minutes that no one read. The third signature endured, and the truth lay pressed between the pages of a leather folder that gathered dust behind a steel door.
wrong_accusation.es: El miembro equivocado fue acusado, y Agnes Vail dejo el Club Blackwood con sus guantes puestos y la confianza de su familia intacta. La escritura falsificada permanecio en la boveda del archivo, la propiedad quedo en manos de los Vail, y el descubrimiento de Arthur Crisp fue discretamente archivado entre las actas del comite que nadie leia. La tercera firma perduro, y la verdad quedo prensada entre las paginas de una carpeta de cuero que acumulaba polvo detras de una puerta de acero.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais membre a ete accuse, et Agnes Vail a quitte le Club Blackwood avec ses gants et la fiducie de sa famille intacte. L'acte falsifie est reste dans la chambre forte des archives, la propriete est restee aux mains des Vail, et la decouverte d'Arthur Crisp a ete discretement classee parmi les proces-verbaux du comite que personne ne lisait. La troisieme signature a perdure, et la verite est restee pressee entre les pages d'un dossier en cuir qui prenait la poussiere derriere une porte d'acier.

cold_case.en: The Blackwood Club filed Arthur Crisp's death under natural causes and resumed its Thursday dinners without him. The trust deed was returned to the vault, the archive key rehung on its peg, and the port decanter was rinsed and refilled. No independent analysis was ever conducted, no committee meeting convened to discuss the ink discrepancy. The third signature remained unchallenged, and the club carried its secret in the same silence with which it carried its port — carefully, through panelled corridors, without spilling a drop.
cold_case.es: El Club Blackwood archivo la muerte de Arthur Crisp como causas naturales y reanudo sus cenas de los jueves sin el. La escritura fiduciaria fue devuelta a la boveda, la llave del archivo colgada de nuevo en su gancho, y el decantador de oporto fue enjuagado y rellenado. Nunca se realizo un analisis independiente, ningun comite se reunio para discutir la discrepancia de tinta. La tercera firma quedo sin cuestionar, y el club llevo su secreto en el mismo silencio con que llevaba su oporto — con cuidado, por pasillos revestidos de madera, sin derramar una gota.
cold_case.fr: Le Club Blackwood a classe la mort d'Arthur Crisp en causes naturelles et a repris ses diners du jeudi sans lui. L'acte fiduciaire a ete rendu a la chambre forte, la cle des archives raccrochee a son crochet, et le carafon de porto rince et rempli a nouveau. Aucune analyse independante n'a jamais ete menee, aucune reunion du comite convoquee pour discuter de l'anomalie d'encre. La troisieme signature est restee incontestee, et le club a porte son secret dans le meme silence avec lequel il portait son porto — avec precaution, a travers des couloirs lambrises, sans en renverser une goutte.

lucky_guess.en: Agnes Vail's name was spoken because the handwriting leaned left and the trust bore her family's name. It was suspicion built on penmanship and inheritance, not forensics. The port glass offered no prints, the antimony no provenance, and the kitchen passage no footsteps. She was convicted because the story fit, and at the Blackwood Club, a good story has always been enough to settle an account.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Agnes Vail fue pronunciado porque la escritura se inclinaba a la izquierda y la escritura fiduciaria llevaba el nombre de su familia. Era sospecha construida sobre caligrafia y herencia, no sobre forense. La copa de oporto no ofrecio huellas, el antimonio ninguna procedencia, y el pasillo de la cocina ningun paso. Fue condenada porque la historia encajaba, y en el Club Blackwood, una buena historia siempre ha sido suficiente para saldar una cuenta.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom d'Agnes Vail a ete prononce parce que l'ecriture penchait a gauche et que la fiducie portait le nom de sa famille. C'etait un soupcon bati sur la calligraphie et l'heritage, pas sur la medecine legale. Le verre de porto n'offrait pas d'empreintes, l'antimoine aucune provenance, et le passage de la cuisine aucun pas. Elle a ete condamnee parce que l'histoire cadrait, et au Club Blackwood, une bonne histoire a toujours suffi pour regler un compte.

expressions.suspect:agnes_vail: Agnes Vail wore black gloves throughout the evening and did not remove them. Her handwriting sloped leftward in the guest book.
expressions.event:evening_port: The port served after dinner contained a measured dose of antimony. The sediment in the glass disguised the compound.
expressions.motive:1921_scandal: A scandal in 1921 involved the forging of a trust deed signature. The third signatory was fabricated and the beneficiary was the Vail family.
expressions.suspect:hugh_emberly: Hugh Emberly arrived early and took his usual chair by the fire. His monogram ring caught the lamplight when he reached for his glass.
expressions.suspect:colonel_norris: Colonel Norris decanted the port himself, as he had done for twenty years. He poured five glasses and carried the tray to the reading room.
expressions.suspect:dr_pryce: Dr Pryce examined the body and pronounced death at half past seven. His notes on the toxicology were detailed and complete by nine.
expressions.suspect:lillian_march: Lillian March crossed the rear garden to speak with the night watchman. Her coat carried rain and her hem was muddied.
expressions.suspect:percival_dent: Percival Dent held the club's archive key and had accessed the vault that afternoon. He claimed he was cataloguing the 1920s minutes.
expressions.suspect:walter_kemp: Walter Kemp sat in the far corner of the reading room and said nothing until asked. He knew the Vail family from his years at the trust office.
expressions.location:blackwood_club: The Blackwood Club occupies a Georgian house behind a wrought-iron gate. Members enter through a panelled lobby and sign the guest book.
expressions.location:reading_room: The reading room holds leather chairs and a sideboard where the port is served. Arthur Crisp was found slumped in the chair nearest the window.
expressions.location:archive_vault: The archive vault sits below the committee room, behind a steel door. The humidity is controlled and the shelves hold records from 1870.
expressions.location:dining_hall: The dining hall seats forty at a single oak table. Dinner ended at half past eight and the port ceremony followed.
expressions.location:committee_room: The committee room contains a round table and six chairs. The minute books line one wall and the trust deeds fill a locked drawer.
expressions.location:port_cellar: The port cellar is reached by a narrow stair behind the kitchen. Colonel Norris selected a 1963 vintage from the second rack.
expressions.location:rear_garden: The rear garden backs onto a mews lane with no gate. Rain began at nine and the gravel paths turned to mud.
expressions.location:cloakroom: The cloakroom holds coats and umbrellas on brass hooks. Agnes Vail's gloves were found in her coat pocket, still damp.
expressions.object:port_decanter: The port decanter was found on the reading room sideboard, nearly empty. A faint cloudiness sat at the base of the crystal.
expressions.object:deed_of_trust: The trust deed dated 1921 requires three signatures to be valid. The third signature does not appear in any other club record.
expressions.object:forged_signature: The third signature on the trust deed was written in an ink available only after 1935. The hand matches Agnes Vail's leftward slope.
expressions.object:toxicology_report: The toxicology report found antimony tartrate in the stomach contents. The dose was consistent with a measured amount dissolved in fortified wine.
expressions.object:guest_book: The guest book shows five members signed in for dinner. Agnes Vail signed last, at ten minutes past seven.
expressions.object:committee_minutes: The committee minutes from 1921 reference a trust established for the Vail property. The minutes are stamped but one page has been rebound.
expressions.object:writing_sample: A writing sample from Agnes Vail's correspondence matches the slope of the forged signature. The pen pressure is identical in the downstrokes.
expressions.object:cellar_key: The cellar key hangs on a hook behind the kitchen door. Only the steward and Colonel Norris know its location.
expressions.object:port_glass: The port glass beside Crisp's chair shows a residue ring at the two-thirds mark. The rim has been wiped clean of prints.
expressions.object:monogram_ring: Hugh Emberly's monogram ring left an imprint on the armrest leather. The impression places him in the chair opposite Crisp.
expressions.object:photograph_1921: A photograph from 1921 shows the trust signing ceremony. Agnes Vail's father stands behind the table but does not hold a pen.
expressions.object:blotting_paper: The blotting paper on the committee room desk holds a mirror image of a signature. The ink transfer is recent.
expressions.object:archive_folder: A leather folder in the archive vault contains the original trust documents. The folder clasp is scratched as if opened with a pin.
expressions.emotion:studied_composure: She set down her glass before answering and placed both hands on her lap. Her voice did not rise above conversation level.
expressions.emotion:startled_glance: He looked up sharply when the trust deed was mentioned. The fire reflected in his eyes and he blinked twice.
expressions.emotion:careful_diction: Every word was placed with deliberation, as if she were composing a letter aloud. She corrected herself once and continued without pause.
expressions.emotion:rigid_courtesy: The Colonel answered each question with 'quite so' or 'as you say.' His posture did not change throughout the interview.
expressions.emotion:prolonged_silence: He waited eleven seconds before responding to the question about 1921. He then spoke without looking up from his hands.
expressions.emotion:forced_lightness: He made a remark about the quality of the port and smiled. The smile did not reach past his cheekbones.
expressions.modifier:sediment_clouded: The port in the decanter showed cloudiness inconsistent with natural sediment. A chemical precipitate had formed at the base.
expressions.modifier:seal_broken: The wax seal on the trust deed envelope had been broken and re-applied. The second impression used a different shade of red.
expressions.modifier:ink_dated: The ink used for the third signature dates to no earlier than 1935. The other two signatures use ink from 1921.
expressions.modifier:glass_wiped: The port glass rim had been wiped clean of all prints. The stem retained one partial thumbprint.
expressions.modifier:rain_tracked: Rain was tracked into the cloakroom from the rear garden path. The mud pattern matches a woman's shoe in a size six.
expressions.modifier:vault_unlocked: The archive vault door was found unlocked at half past ten. The steward stated it had been locked after dinner.
expressions.modifier:nib_match: The nib width on the forged signature matches a Waterman pen found in Agnes Vail's writing case. The width is unusual.
expressions.modifier:blot_transferred: The blotting paper shows a partial reverse of the third signature. The transfer indicates the signature was made in the committee room.
expressions.modifier:dose_measured: The antimony dose was precise enough to suggest pharmaceutical knowledge. Dr Pryce confirmed the dose would be fatal within two hours.
expressions.modifier:ring_imprint: A ring imprint on the leather armrest places Hugh Emberly in the chair opposite Crisp. The chair faces the window and the sideboard.
expressions.action:port_decanted: The port was decanted from bottle to crystal by Colonel Norris at half past eight. He carried five glasses on a silver tray.
expressions.action:vault_accessed: The archive vault was accessed at 21:15 according to the key log. The entry corresponds to the period after the port was served.
expressions.action:deed_removed: The trust deed was removed from the archive vault and returned within forty minutes. The folder clasp showed fresh scratches.
expressions.action:glass_replaced: One port glass was removed from the tray and replaced with a second containing the prepared dose. The exchange occurred in the kitchen passage.
expressions.action:letter_burned: Fragments of a letter were found in the reading room fireplace. The paper stock matches the Vail family stationery.
expressions.action:garden_crossed: Lillian March crossed the rear garden at approximately nine. The night watchman saw her return through the kitchen entrance.
expressions.action:minutes_consulted: The 1921 committee minutes were consulted in the archive vault. A page corner was turned down that had not been marked before.
expressions.action:sample_compared: A handwriting expert compared the third signature with known Vail samples. The match was conclusive on seven of nine criteria.
expressions.action:cellar_visited: The port cellar was visited twice during the evening. The second visit was not logged by the steward.
expressions.time:after_dinner_hour: Dinner concluded at half past eight. Port was served in the reading room and members retired to their chairs.
expressions.time:rain_began: Rain began at nine and continued past midnight. The rear garden paths became impassable after half past nine.
expressions.time:body_found_morning: Arthur Crisp was found in his chair by the steward at half past six. The fire had died and the port glass stood beside him.
expressions.time:port_served: The port was served at twenty to nine. All five members were present in the reading room when the first glass was poured.
expressions.time:deed_deadline: The trust review was scheduled for the following week. Crisp, as literary executor, had requested the original documents.
expressions.motive:family_honour: If the forged signature were exposed, the Vail family trust would be invalidated. The property holdings would revert to the original estate.
expressions.motive:trust_fraud: The trust deed's third signature was fabricated to create a quorum. Without it, the 1921 transfer of property had no legal standing.
expressions.motive:executor_discovery: Arthur Crisp discovered the ink discrepancy during a routine review. He had requested an independent analysis before the committee meeting.
expressions.motive:property_claim: Percival Dent stood to gain from the trust's dissolution. His family held the original claim to the property before 1921.
expressions.motive:blackmail_fear: Walter Kemp had known about the forged signature for years. His silence had been compensated through an annual payment from the Vail estate.
expressions.witness:club_steward: The steward carried the port tray from the cellar to the reading room. He noticed nothing unusual about the glasses.
expressions.witness:cloakroom_girl: The cloakroom attendant hung Agnes Vail's coat at ten past seven. She noticed the gloves were already damp when she arrived.
expressions.witness:night_watchman: The night watchman saw Lillian March cross the garden at nine. He did not see anyone else use the rear entrance.
expressions.witness:kitchen_staff: The kitchen staff cleared the dining hall at quarter to nine. One member of staff saw a glass being carried through the kitchen passage.
expressions.witness:cab_driver: The cab driver waited outside the club from half past ten. He took Walter Kemp home at eleven and noted his silence.
expressions.event:arthur_crisp_discovered: Arthur Crisp was found in the reading room chair with his port glass beside him. The fire had burned out and the room was cold.
expressions.event:port_ceremony: The port ceremony is a Blackwood tradition following Thursday dinners. Five glasses are poured from a single decanter and served by the senior member.
